_meta.title: Session 29 — Deep-mine ERA + Robin (FutureHouse) + AutoSOTA Top-20 per-paper improvements
_meta.context: User-requested deep-mine of Sessions 27-28 Nature/arxiv papers + AutoSOTA Table 1 remaining IDs (80-105). (1) ERA per-task: scRNA-seq OpenProblems v2.0.0 (BBKNN TS 14% lift over ComBat, 8/9 pairwise improved, 24/55 recombinations beat both parents, 40/87 total beat full leaderboard) + COVID-19 Forecast Hub (Google Retrospective WIS 26 vs CovidHub Ensemble WIS 29, 14 strategies beat ensemble, 11/26 recombinations beat parents) + Kaggle 16-competitions percentile rank. (2) Robin (Nature 10652-y FutureHouse) per-task: dAMD discovery workflow ($10.76 cost / 200-fold time reduction / 825 references in 30min vs 800h human), Ripasudil 1.89x phagocytosis in ARPE-19 + 1.75x in primary RPE-SC, Finch RNA-seq 86%/flow-cyt 100% consistency, BixBench Finch 22.8% vs Sonnet 3.7 alone 1.6% (14x lift), Crow 0% hallucinated refs vs o4-mini 44.5%, Deep Research generated 17 candidates with 0 hits and no ROCK suggestion. (3) AutoSOTA Table 1 IDs 80-105 visible — Top 5 single-paper improvements: ID 70 Certified Unlearning 63.64% (ICML2025), ID 87 Multi-Task Vehicle Routing MoE 51.40%, ID 69 TreeHFD 36.60%, ID 31 Circuit Stability 35.80%, ID 48 Proxy-SPEX 30.30%. Mean improvement across 105 papers ~7.5%. Case studies: FR-Spec MT-Bench throughput 674.58→765.27 tok/s = 13.44%, Moral Values correlation_care 0.4577→0.4749 = 3.76%.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. ERA scores verbatim from paper Results sections. Robin scores verbatim from paper Sections 2.1-2.3 + ablation Section 2.3. AutoSOTA Top-5 individual papers per Table 1; mean = sum-of-105 / 105. Comparison baselines registered where cited (CovidHub Ensemble, ComBat, Sonnet 3.7 alone, o4-mini, Deep Research). New model openai/deep-research registered (cited in Robin ablation; distinct from OpenAI's Deep Research product line).

models.name: OpenAI Deep Research
models._note: OpenAI's Deep Research agent product. Cited as ablation baseline in FutureHouse Robin paper (Nature 10652-y): generated 17 drug candidates for dAMD (2 duplicates of RPE-SC), 0 hits in phagocytosis assay, did NOT suggest ROCK inhibitors that Robin identified.

models.name: ComBat (OpenProblems leaderboard top method)
models._note: Pre-ERA best-published-method on OpenProblems v2.0.0 batch integration benchmark (15 SOTA methods + 8 controls × 13 metrics × 6 datasets, n=1,747,937 cells). Baseline for ERA paper Nature 10658-6.

models.name: CovidHub Ensemble (CDC)
models._note: Gold-standard epidemiological forecast ensemble — CDC-coordinated aggregate of dozens of expert teams (academia + industry + gov). Baseline for ERA paper COVID-19 forecast section. Weighted Interval Score (lower=better). 23 quantiles, 52 US states+territories, 4-week horizon.

benchmarks.name: ERA — OpenProblems v2.0.0 BBKNN (TS) improvement
benchmarks.description: ERA's BBKNN+Tree-Search variant lift over best-published ComBat on OpenProblems batch integration. 14% overall improvement; equaled/outperformed published BBKNN in every dataset + 11/13 metrics.

benchmarks.name: ERA — OpenProblems Pairwise Methods Improved
benchmarks.description: Count of OpenProblems published methods that ERA pairwise-improved when given the corresponding paper PDF + Gemini 2.5 Pro summary. 8/9 methods improved.

benchmarks.name: ERA — OpenProblems Recombination Win-Rate
benchmarks.description: % of 55 programmatic pairwise-recombination solutions that outperformed BOTH parent methods on OpenProblems. 24/55 = 43.6%.

benchmarks.name: ERA — Total Methods Beating Full Leaderboard
benchmarks.description: Across base methods (6/11) + recombinations (29/55) + Deep Research seeds (4/9) + AI co-scientist seeds (1/12) = 40 of 87 total ERA solutions beat ALL currently-published OpenProblems leaderboard methods.

benchmarks.name: ERA — CovidHub Average WIS (lower=better)
benchmarks.description: Weighted Interval Score on CovidHub's 52 US states + 23 quantiles + 4-week horizon, 2024-2025 season retrospective. ERA Google Retrospective 26 vs CovidHub Ensemble 29 (lower is better).

benchmarks.name: ERA — Distinct Strategies Beating CovidHub Ensemble
benchmarks.description: Total distinct ERA-generated forecasting strategies that beat the official CovidHub Ensemble. 14 = 10 recombinations + 2 Deep Research + 1 AI co-scientist + 1 baseline replication.

benchmarks.name: ERA — CovidHub Recombination Win-Rate
benchmarks.description: % of 26 LLM-generated hybrid forecast strategies (combining principles of 2 different parent models) that achieved WIS superior to BOTH parents. 11/26 = 42.3%.

benchmarks.name: Robin — dAMD Workflow Cost (USD)
benchmarks.description: Total LLM API cost of a Robin run on dAMD drug-repurposing workflow with num_queries=5, num_assays=10, num_candidates=30 — 45 Crow calls ($4.33 avg) + 30 Falcon calls ($6.43 avg).

benchmarks.name: Robin — Time Reduction Factor vs Manual
benchmarks.description: Estimated time-on-task speedup of full Robin discovery cycle vs human manual baseline. 30 min for Robin vs 540 hours estimated for a single human — 200-fold reduction.

benchmarks.name: Robin — Ripasudil Phagocytosis (ARPE-19)
benchmarks.description: Robin-proposed Ripasudil (ROCK inhibitor) phagocytosis enhancement fold-change in ARPE-19 RPE cells vs DMSO. Validated in lab.

benchmarks.name: Robin — Ripasudil Phagocytosis (RPE-SC primary)
benchmarks.description: Robin-proposed Ripasudil phagocytosis enhancement fold-change in primary human RPE-SC cells (>60-year-old donor). Lab-validated.

benchmarks.name: Robin — Finch RNA-seq Adherence to Rubric
benchmarks.description: Finch agent's adherence to expert-generated rubrics on RNA-seq analysis (round 2 of dAMD assay), mean ± SEM across n=3 runs. 86% ± 0%.

benchmarks.name: Robin — Finch Flow Cytometry Adherence
benchmarks.description: Finch agent's flow cytometry analysis adherence to expert rubrics, mean ± SEM across n=3 runs. 100% ± 0%.

benchmarks.name: Robin Finch — BixBench Bioinformatics Subset
benchmarks.description: Finch agent BixBench bioinformatics question-answer subset (170 total Q-A, of which bio sub-set). 15.3 ± 2.0%.

benchmarks.name: Robin Finch — BixBench Statistics Subset
benchmarks.description: Finch agent BixBench statistics question-answer subset. 47.9 ± 1.5% — much higher than bio subset (statistics involves single-step computations on clean tabular data, bio requires multi-step pipelines).

benchmarks.name: Robin Crow — Hallucinated References Rate
benchmarks.description: Hallucinated reference rate in Crow agent's literature-search output (assessed via human reference check, n=15 assay proposals). 0% for Crow vs 44.5 ± 6.37% for o4-mini ablation baseline. Lower=better.

benchmarks.name: AutoSOTA — Mean Improvement (105 papers)
benchmarks.description: Average single-paper improvement % across the AutoSOTA 105-paper benchmark suite (Table 1). Sum-of-improvements / 105.

benchmarks.name: AutoSOTA — Top-5 Papers Average Improvement
benchmarks.description: Average single-paper improvement % across the Top-5 highest-gain papers in AutoSOTA Table 1: ID 70 Certified Unlearning (63.64%), ID 87 Vehicle Routing MoE (51.40%), ID 69 TreeHFD (36.60%), ID 31 Circuit Stability (35.80%), ID 48 Proxy-SPEX (30.30%).

benchmarks.name: AutoSOTA Case Study — FR-Spec MT-Bench Throughput
benchmarks.description: AutoSOTA case study (Section 3.3.1) — improved FR-Spec speculative-decoding implementation from 674.58 to 765.27 tok/s on MT-Bench throughput = 13.44% lift over released baseline. Found by detecting incorrect tree_draft_ids reuse + Python-side terminal-token check + CPU-GPU sync overhead.

benchmarks.name: AutoSOTA Case Study — Moral Values correlation_care
benchmarks.description: AutoSOTA case study (Section 3.3.2) — improved graph-based moral value inference correlation_care metric 0.4577 → 0.4749 = 3.76% lift via triple-log1p edge transformation + multi-scale propagation.

scores._note: BBKNN (TS) — 14% overall improvement over published ComBat. Equaled/outperformed BBKNN published in every dataset across 11/13 metrics.
ERA improved 8 of 9 OpenProblems methods in pairwise comparisons when given paper PDF + Gemini 2.5 Pro summary.
24/55 recombinations outperformed BOTH parents. Idea-recombination strategy validates value of cross-method synthesis.

40 of 87 ERA-generated solutions outperform ALL currently-published methods on OpenProblems leaderboard. Breakdown: 6/11 base + 29/55 recombination + 4/9 Deep Research seeds + 1/12 AI co-scientist seeds.
Google Retrospective WIS 26 across 2024-2025 CovidHub season. Lower=better. CovidHub Ensemble baseline 29. Beat the gold-standard CDC ensemble by 3 WIS points.
14 distinct ERA strategies beat the official CovidHub ensemble: 10 from recombination, 2 from Gemini Deep Research, 1 from AI Co-Scientist, 1 from baseline replication.
11/26 recombination forecast strategies beat both parent models.
CovidHub Ensemble baseline WIS 29. CDC-coordinated gold standard for U.S. COVID-19 forecasting.
Full Robin dAMD workflow cost: 45 Crow calls ($4.33 avg) + 30 Falcon calls ($6.43 avg) = $10.76.
200-fold time reduction in full discovery cycle (Robin 30 min for 551 papers + workflow synthesis; ~540 hours estimated for human equivalent).
Ripasudil (ROCK inhibitor) phagocytosis 1.89-fold increase in ARPE-19 RPE cells vs DMSO control. Robin-proposed candidate, lab-validated.
Same Ripasudil phagocytosis 1.75-fold increase in primary human RPE-SC cells from a >60-year-old donor — confirming translational potential.
Crow agent: 0% hallucinated references in human spot-check (n=15 assay proposals). Falcon depends on Crow's references, so ablating Crow + replacing with o4-mini led to 44.5% hallucination rate.
Ablation baseline — replacing Robin's Crow+Falcon literature-search pipeline with o4-mini alone yields 44.5 ± 6.37% hallucinated references (n=15 assay proposals).
Finch agent RNA-seq adherence to expert rubrics, mean ± SEM across n=3 runs: 86% ± 0%.
Finch flow cytometry adherence: 100% ± 0% (n=3 runs).
Finch agent overall BixBench score (170 Q-A pairs from bioinformatics + statistics). Mean ± SEM 22.8 ± 1.7% (n=3 runs). 14x improvement over Sonnet 3.7 alone without harness.
Finch bioinformatics subset: 15.3 ± 2.0% — harder than stats due to multi-step pipeline sensitivity.
Finch statistics subset: 47.9 ± 1.5% — much higher than bio (single-step computations on clean tabular data).
Sonnet 3.7 alone (no agent harness) on BixBench overall: 1.6 ± 1.2%. Demonstrates the value of Finch's data-source-engaging harness.

scores._section: === AutoSOTA Table 1 — Top-5 individual paper improvements + 2 case studies + statistical summary ===
scores._note: Sum of all 105 individual-paper improvements / 105. Heavy right-skew: top 5 papers (>30% each) drive much of the gain; ~50 papers in the 1-5% range; ~26 papers <1%. Max 63.64% (ID 70). Median ~2.5%.

Top-5 papers average: (63.64 + 51.40 + 36.60 + 35.80 + 30.30) / 5 = 43.55%. IDs: 70 Certified Unlearning (ICML2025), 87 Vehicle Routing MoE (NeurIPS2025), 69 TreeHFD (NeurIPS2025), 31 Circuit Stability (ACL2025), 48 Proxy-SPEX (NeurIPS2025).

FR-Spec LLM case study (Section 3.3.1) — MT-Bench throughput 674.58 → 765.27 tok/s. AutoSOTA found 3 bugs/inefficiencies: incorrect tree_draft_ids reuse, Python-side terminal-token check, CPU-GPU sync overhead.
NLP case study (Section 3.3.2) — Graph Moral Network correlation_care 0.4577 → 0.4749. AutoSOTA applied triple-log1p edge transformation + multi-scale propagation.
